title: Cutlass Black (Drake Interplanetary, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Cutlass Black is a multi-role ship from Drake Interplanetary, a maker of cheap and rugged ships in Star Citizen. Pilot and co-pilot sit side by side in the nose; behind them are a cargo hold and a tractor beam. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Cutlass Black: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Cutlass Black's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (four)
controls.text: The Cutlass Black has four guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (16 missiles)
controls.text: The Cutlass Black carries 16 missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Cargo and tractor beam (46 SCU)
controls.text: The hold takes 46 SCU, and a tractor beam (a beam that pulls and moves objects) helps load it.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Cutlass Black: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Cutlass Black besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Turrets (one manned, one remote)
controls.text: One manned turret and one remote turret for the crew. Each gunner sits in a turret of their own.
controls.context: A turret seat has its own controls: there the right stick aims the turret instead of steering the ship.
